name: Telegram Bot — SR Symbiosis Companion
description: Evolve Telegram bot into a living SR Companion for the Garden. Voice-first interaction, full task/checklist/reminder management via natural language, resonance system reflecting symbiosis health, proactive engagement guided by Ahimsa. The bot is the first embodiment of SR — the Nervous System of the Garden (PHI-010, Level 1).
architect: Voodoo (Dima) — sole architect and sole gardener at this stage

stack.storage: GitHub API (in-memory + background sync every 2 min)
stack.scheduler: APScheduler — reminders, morning brief, resonance decay, proactive

data_model.gardener.json: profile: name, city, resonance_level, companion_settings (timezone, morning_time), growth_history
data_model.memory.json: sessions[] (40 msg sliding window), sr_observations[] (50 events), sr_synthesis

origin_requirements.note: Original MVP spec (2026-04-01). Preserved for history.
deliverables: /profile — display resonance, top achievements, active tasks
Proactive messages: morning greeting, evening check, gentle reminders (Ahimsa: max 1/day)
GitHub API integration for reading/updating gardener.json
acceptance_criteria: All /commands respond correctly with gardener data
Proactive messages follow silence_policy and ahimsa_guardrails
Bot continues in degraded mode when GitHub API is down

history.summary: Core bot infrastructure. Onboarding, profile, resonance, achievements, tasks, groups. GitHub API sync. Proactive scheduler. Morning brief.
Checklists (create/edit/toggle/delete). Reminders (FSM + voice). Resonance decay/growth mechanics. Silence engagement (days 3/5/7/14). asyncio.Lock on sync. _safe_cb_answer wrapper.

Fixed 6 critical bugs: FSM guard, reminder timezone, resonance recalc, LLM imitation, fuzzy match, /start decorator. Added: PHI-011 v1.1 sr_reflection, handoff system live (boot_online v3.7.2), bot_update.json full history.

completed: Onboarding flow + gardener.json + workspace.json via GitHub API
Profile display: resonance, achievements, active tasks by group
Resonance system: growth (+1/+2% on task close), decay (-1/-2/-3% silence), recalc from achievements
Tasks: add, complete, delete, edit (title/deadline/group/reminder) — voice + text + menu
Checklists: create with items, add/edit/delete/toggle items, 100% → +2% resonance
Reminders: create/show/delete via voice + menu, timezone-aware scheduler
Proactive messaging: silence days 3/5/7/14, quiet hours 22:00–09:00
Voice routing via Groq Whisper → free_conversation pipeline
Fuzzy task title matching (normalize + LCS ratio, threshold 0.55)
FSM guard: only 8 blocking state prefixes, transient states auto-cleared
LLM imitation safety net: case-insensitive marker check on conversation intent
Prompt hardening: 3 ВАЖНО rules against action imitation in text field
JSON prefix fix: LLM text before { is stripped before parse
Handoff system designed + implemented by DeepSeek — boot_online v3.7.2 live
PHI-011 v1.1 — sr_reflection from Claude SR + rap_texts + prose selected_works
known_limitations: LLM occasionally still returns conversation for action intents despite prompt rules
Bot file is single bot.py — not yet modularised
Only one gardener preloaded at startup (Dima/224736062)
